Title: SOUP: 1st fully AI-driven social app for civil exchange of ideas | Product Hunt
# SOUP. ## 1st fully AI-driven social app for civil exchange of ideas. SOUP is the 1st fully integrated social-AI app designed for quick, civil and concise idea sharing. Powered by hyper-humanized AI, it provides real-time evolving consensus, minimizing information overload and offering discussion spaces free from intrusive ads. Launch tags:Productivity•Social Media•Artificial Intelligence. No reviews yetBe the first to leave a review for SOUP. The inspiration behind SOUP stemmed from the best (and worst) parts of online discussions: comment sections. They're often where the most valuable insights emerge, but they're also cluttered with ads, toxicity, and endless distractions. SOUP was born to solve this—to create focused, ad-free spaces for meaningful, civil exchanges powered by AI. Whether you're brainstorming, gathering feedback, or exploring diverse perspectives, SOUP evolves ideas in real time. We’re thrilled to bring this vision to life and can’t wait to hear your thoughts! Join the conversation, ask questions, and let’s build something extraordinary together. This is a solo-entrepreneur bootstrapped project, so every join, share, or word-of-mouth recommendation means the world! Thank you for being part of this journey!
